question: Do Luxembourg's exports have a seasonal pattern? — projection (refined)

limitations.message: Values are in current euros (nominal), not adjusted for price changes.
The projection only extends past patterns. It is not an official forecast and includes no prices, policy or company decisions.

sql:
SELECT
  period,
  flow,
  SUM(value_eur) AS value_eur,
  SUM(qty_kg) AS qty_kg
FROM v_lu_trade_hs2
WHERE
  period >= CAST('2002-01-01' AS DATE) AND period < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
GROUP BY
  period,
  flow
ORDER BY
  period
LIMIT 10000
title: exports: 1.34 bn € Dec 2026
insight: Luxembourg's exports do not show a strong seasonal pattern, as the export projection for December 2026 is the same as the actual exports in December 2025, at 1.34 billion euros.
The export projection uses a seasonal-naive method, which assumes exports will be similar to the same month last year.
This method was chosen because it performed better than more complex models in recent back-tests, with a mean absolute percentage error of 7.9%.
In contrast, imports show a seasonal pattern and are projected using a model that includes monthly seasonality, with imports in December 2026 projected at 2.17 billion euros.
The data are nominal values and the projections only extend past patterns; they are not official forecasts and do not account for price changes, policy, or company decisions.
